description:
Nemesis Shield - Sentinel SDK for Java. Positive-security runtime protection: learns your
    app's normal behavior and blocks off-baseline requests (auth bypass, path traversal, scanners,
    unusual methods) in enforce mode, plus an OWASP-LLM prompt-injection guard backed by an embedded
    ML model (byte-identical across all Nemesis Shield SDKs). Servlet filter included. Fail-open,
    privacy-preserving, JDK 11+.
